title: Software Development Engineer 1
description:
**About the Team & Role**

Team builds the infrastructure that keeps commercial drivers and fleets moving from fuel payments at the pump to the apps and backend services that power authorizations, loyalty, and real-time transaction data. As an SDE I, you'll join one of two full-stack engineering teams within WEX's Mobility organization.

  
  

Both teams own their systems end to end. The 10-4 (OTR) team builds the over-the-road platform customer-facing APIs, event-driven microservices (Java/Spring Boot, Python), Kafka-based async

processing, payment and identity integrations (Fiserv, Okta), and the Android and iOS apps that drivers use in the field. The NA Mobility Platform team builds and owns the shared frontend infrastructure that product teams across the organization depend on Angular micro-frontends with NestJS BFFs, Module Federation, a shared component library (Theseus UI), brand theming, and app scaffolding via Theseus Builder. In both cases, you'll work across layers of a real production stack, ship to real users, and be supported by engineers who care about doing the work well. We value clean APIs, strong testing habits, and engineers who improve the systems they touch. You'll work closely with the product, other OTR teams, and your peers on features from design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Build specific components within an established architecture.
* You'll follow the patterns your team has set, whether that's microservices, event-driven design, or component-based frontend, and implement features correctly within those structures rather than redefining them.
* Write clean, compilable code with unit tests that meet the team's quality standards.
* Before you start building, you'll ask the right questions about acceptance criteria and error states so you're solving the right problem, not just writing code.
* Identify and fix bugs in well-defined tasks.
* You'll reproduce issues, pinpoint where in the code they're happening, and work with senior engineers to land the right fix rather than just patching the symptom.
* Handle low-priority support tickets as a first responder and participate in on-call rotations under supervision.
* During incidents, you'll run specific checks and scripts as directed, building your confidence with live systems gradually and safely.
* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the
* Definition of Done, moving tickets through the right stages, and raising a flag immediately if something is at risk.
* You don't deviate from the team's agreed process without checking first.
* Show up fully in team rituals like standups, backlog grooming, and demos.
* You'll listen to stakeholder feedback during demos to understand how your work actually lands with users, not just whether it passed the acceptance criteria.
* Use AI tools like Cursor or similar to reduce boilerplate, get unstuck faster, and understand error messages more quickly. You own the quality of everything you ship though, which means validating AI-generated output rather than passing it through unchecked.
* Update documentation when you find something inaccurate or missing. Good documentation is part of the job, and you'll be expected to keep it honest as you learn the system.
  

  

**Experience You'll Bring**

* You have a solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, and software design from a B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science from a reputed institution, with 0 to 1 year of professional experience.
* You're comfortable writing clean, compilable, tested code in at least one of Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript, and you understand what makes code maintainable, not just functional.
* You understand the testing pyramid and have written unit tests as part of coursework, an internship, or a personal project. You see tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought.
* You know never to hardcode secrets, you have a basic understanding of IAM and role-based access control, and you're willing to learn which compliance requirements like PCI or SOC apply to the systems you work on.
* You know your way around Git and pull requests, can deploy to an existing CI/CD pipeline, and can tell when your specific commit caused a build failure.
* When you're blocked, you ask focused questions and explain what you've already tried. You flag a deadline risk the moment you see it, not the day before it's due.
* You receive code review feedback without getting defensive, you actively learn your team's standards and tools, and you're comfortable switching between tasks within a project when priorities shift.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A degree in computer science software engineering from a reputed institution.
* Internship or co-op experience where you shipped real code to a production or staging environment as part of a team.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Familiarity with cloud basics even through coursework or personal projects.
* Exposure to containerization through Docker. Reading and running existing Dockerfiles counts, you don't need to have written them from scratch.
* Some experience working in an existing codebase, contributin improvements, and navigating code you didn't write yourself.
* Awareness of AI tools beyond code completion, such as experimenting with prompt design or modifying a simple AI-powered script or agent.
* A genuine interest in the domain. Payments, fleet operations, or developer platform work are exciting problem spaces and it helps to be curious about the industry, not just the technology.

description:
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.

This role is suited for a strong hands-on software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing modern applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments.

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features and services from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, integration, troubleshooting, and production readiness.

  

**Core Technical Qualifications**

The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience with most of the following:

* Modern full-stack application development

* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering

* RESTful APIs and backend service development

* .NET and C# development

* Microservices and distributed-system concepts

* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
* + RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology
* + SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms
* + Caching technologies such as Redis
* + Data-processing and persistence concepts
* + Authentication, authorization, and secure API design
* + Automated unit, API, component, and integration testing
* + Observability, structured logging, and production troubleshooting
* + Git-based development, branching, pull-request, and release workflows
* Strong hands-on experience with .NET/C# is particularly relevant to the existing platform-services landscape.

  + 5+ years of professional software-development experience, with substantial hands-on development responsibility.

  + Strong experience building production-quality backend, full-stack, or platform software.

  + Experience developing services using microservice, API-driven, and distributed-system architectures.

  + Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD.

  + Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features.

  + Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments.

  **Preferred / Differentiating Experience**

  Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

  + Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms

  + Edge computing or appliance-based software

  + Hybrid-cloud or multi-cloud platforms

  + Air-gapped or restricted-connectivity environments

  + Large-scale telemetry or event-processing systems

  + Kubernetes-based edge deployments

  + Time-series databases

  + Device and gateway management

  + Secure software-development lifecycle practices

  

* Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components.

* Implement well-defined service interfaces, APIs, contracts, and reusable abstractions.

* Develop event-driven services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies and asynchronous processing patterns.

* Build services interacting with relational databases, time-series data stores, caching technologies, and file/object storage.

* Implement reliable service-to-service communication, error handling, retry, and integration patterns.

* Troubleshoot issues across distributed services and their dependencies.

* Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments.

* Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations.

* Apply abstraction and adapter patterns where needed to minimize unnecessary cloud-provider dependencies.

* Develop software capable of operating in Cognition edge/appliance environments, including deployments with limited or restricted connectivity.

* Build platform components with appropriate consideration for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization.

* Develop and support services deployed in Kubernetes-based environments.

* Contribute to installation, configuration, upgrade, and lifecycle-management capabilities for platform services.

* Follow engineering and security requirements associated with regulated, restricted-connectivity, or air-gapped deployments.

**Engineering & Collaboration Expectations**

* Take ownership of assigned features, services, and technical problems with limited supervision.

* Translate technical designs and requirements into high-quality working software.

* Participate constructively in architecture and design discussions.

* Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain engineering standards.

* Collaborate effectively with technical leads, architects, Product Owners, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, and application teams.

* Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early.

* Diagnose technical issues spanning applications, services, messaging, databases, Kubernetes, and infrastructure.

* Contribute to technical investigations and proof-of-concepts for new technologies or platform capabilities.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior Software Developer: Full-stack
description:
At Tecsys, the software we deliver keeps hospitals, pharmacies and distributors supplied with what they need, when they need it. Every role here connects to that outcome.

***Why This Role Matters***

As a Senior Software Developer you will join our OmniWMS Product & Technology team, a team at the heart of the evolution of our multi-component Warehouse Management System, a distributed platform that powers mission-critical warehouse operations around the world. You’ll deliver release features across both the legacy and modern parts of the platform, working end to end across front end, back end and database. You’ll troubleshoot complex issues, improve the performance of high-volume workflows and help modernize the platform step by step, using AI-assisted development to move faster while applying sound engineering judgment. Along the way you’ll learn the WMS domain and work with AWS-native services and AI built into the product, adding value by keeping critical warehouse operations stable while the platform evolves.

**What You’ll Be Part Of**

Tecsys is trusted by mission-critical organizations in healthcare and distribution to power resilient, efficient and secure supply chains. We are a global provider of cloud-based, AI-driven software, publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: TCS).

**Three values guide how we work**. We earn trust daily by valuing the customer and acting with integrity. We build each other up by recognizing individual strengths and working as one team. And we explore boldly by staying curious and adapting for success.

You’ll join a culture driven by curiosity, continuous learning, and people who challenge what’s possible.

 **Requirements**

***What You’ll Do***

* Build and ship release features and enhancements on our multi-component WMS platform, working across front end, back end and database.
* Work across legacy and modern technology stacks, including .NET/C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, MVC and Entity Framework, while helping improve architecture, maintainability and testability over time.
* Contribute to modernization initiatives such as migrating legacy components, upgrading frameworks and refactoring.
* Troubleshoot and debug issues end to end, and optimize high-volume transactional workflows on SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
* Develop responsive web and mobile interfaces used in daily warehouse operations, using JavaScript, Vue, jQuery, Razor Views and PWA components.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to understand code, accelerate delivery and support modernization, reviewing all AI-generated output with sound judgment.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, QA, product managers and support teams, and take part in code reviews and technical design discussions.

***What You Bring***

You do not need to match every line below. If most of it describes you, apply:

* 3–7 years of full-stack software development experience, with strong programming and object-oriented design fundamentals.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and debugging skills, and the ability to learn quickly in unfamiliar codebases and technology stacks.
* Hands-on backend experience in .NET/C#, Java or a similar enterprise stack, including REST APIs and ORM frameworks. Prior .NET experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript with a modern front-end framework. Vue is preferred; React or Angular experience is welcome if you can transition to Vue quickly.
* Solid working knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including complex queries and performance troubleshooting.
* Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to understand code and deliver changes, with the judgment to review what they produce.

**Business Justification as to why this hire is required, is this a backfill or additional headcount:**

  

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

**Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:**

  

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

  

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

* Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

* Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

* End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

* Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

* Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

* AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. Apply engineering judgment, security discipline, source review, and thorough validation before adoption.

* Collaboration and technical leadership: Partner with Bluetooth firmware, audio, systems, platform, application, test, product, and customer engineering teams. Drive design reviews, mentor engineers, identify risks early, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly.

  

Qualifications needed

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

* 6+ years of embedded software development experience, with strong hands-on development in C/C++ for wireless connectivity or comparable embedded products.

* Strong working knowledge of Bluetooth architecture, host-controller interactions, and Bluetooth Classic/BLE protocols, with the ability to scale rapidly into unfamiliar protocols, profiles, specifications, and product use cases.

* Excellent C programming, data-structure, concurrency, memory-management, and defensive-programming skills.

* Strong analytical problem-solving ability, including decomposition of ambiguous system issues, hypothesis-driven debugging, trade-off evaluation, and root-cause isolation across software and hardware boundaries.

* Experience with IPC, multithreading, synchronization, transport interfaces, embedded storage, logging, and debugging of distributed or multi-processor systems.

* Ability to read specifications, architecture documents, code, traces, and logs and convert them into clear designs and reliable implementations.

* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including design documentation, technical presentations, and cross-functional reviews.

Minimum Qualifications:

* Demonstrated ability to design, port, debug, and optimize complex software on Linux and/or RTOS environments.

* Experience porting a protocol stack to MCU, or RTOS-based low-power execution environments.

* Practical experience using enterprise-approved generative AI or coding assistants, with a strong understanding of validation, confidentiality, licensing, and secure-development expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience integrating Bluetooth audio and connectivity services, including A2DP, AVRCP, HFP, LE Audio, audio routing, and session control.

* Experience with Bluetooth sniffers, air traces, HCI snoop logs, protocol analyzers, embedded debuggers, crash dumps, and performance/power profiling.

description:
Software Engineer (Full Stack)

Maersk is hiring Software Engineers who can work across the stack to join the Visibility Platform team. The platform answers the questions "where is my shipment?" and "when will I get it?" with a high level of accuracy and timeliness. It is powered by tons of data from multiple sources, and this role provides an opportunity to innovate on how the right subset of that data is processed, served and presented to users in the right context.

About the role

In this role, you will work on a greenfield project that aims to provide increased quality of visibility into the movements of containerised shipments and associated attributes like delays, extra charges incurred, emissions, etc.

You will lead and own the features you pick up from first prototype to production, working across the tech stack. You will move comfortably between the front-end and the back-end, using modern coding agents to move fast and teammates for review and guidance.

Here are some of the things the role involves:

* Independently lead and own the design, delivery and long-term health of the features and services you build.

* Contribute freely to both the web front-end and the back-end services, using coding agents to explore unfamiliar code, produce working changes, and learn conventions as you go. Take responsibility for what you ship, regardless of who or what wrote the first draft.

* Work closely with the UX and product team to iterate and provide feedback on mocks and designs and how well they solve user problems.

* Build quick prototypes for exploring concepts. Be happy to throw some away and evolve others into solutions that are maintainable for a long time.

* Work backwards from the mocks and help design API structures that can power the views in an efficient and performant manner. Where existing APIs can be limiting, help explore alternate options in design that don't degrade the originally intended user experience.

* While building views, care deeply about semantic HTML, accessibility and rendering

performance, often with each going hand-in-hand with the other.

* While building services, build event driven applications and microservice-based APIs with a lot of focus on scalability, reliability and secure practices from the ground up.

* Work with Maersk's design system conventions and ensure consistency in design language across multiple micro-applications. Know when the conventions can be limiting and be comfortable stepping out of them.

* Ensure hygiene practices like test coverage, performance profiling, security checks etc. are put in place and gated with automated checks.

* Ensure applications emit the standard signals needed for effective monitoring and alerting.

* Actively participate in code reviews and encourage using them as a tool for team members to learn from each other. Review agent-assisted changes with the same rigour as any other.

* Contribute to a culture of continuous delivery where the path from code commit to going live is as automated as it can be.

* Work in an inclusive manner with team members across geographies, time zones and cultures.

About you

Here are some things we expect from you for the role.

Minimum qualifications

* Be highly proficient with either the back-end or the front-end, as described below. This is the minimum bar, and you should be able to independently lead and own delivery of major components, pages or services there with very little hand-holding.

* Back-end: Java or Kotlin and a framework like Spring Boot, with experience building event driven applications and microservice-based APIs that handle a huge amount of data.

* Front-end: Vue, React, Svelte or Angular, TypeScript, semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive design. We mainly use Vue, so be open to it.

* Be able to contribute across the other side with the help of coding agents: enough familiarity to read the code, judge what an agent produces, write and run tests, and know when to ask a teammate for a second pair of eyes.

* Be adept at using modern LLM-based coding agents (like Claude Code or GitHub Copilot) to increase quality and speed of work, including giving them good context, verifying their output,and recognising when they are going wrong.

* Be highly proficient with a test framework like JUnit or Jest, and be a natural at always

maintaining high test coverage for any code written.

* Be familiar with analysing the algorithmic complexity of code, common design patterns and when to use them.

* Be familiar with at least one relational and one NoSQL database, and with observability concepts: logging, metrics, traces and alerts.

* Be familiar with cloud computing concepts and able to put them into practice, with experience in at least one of Azure, Google Cloud or AWS.

* Be familiar with a build system like Webpack, and with Node.js and the npm ecosystem. Be aware of common reusable open-source libraries, and mindful of not causing bloated dependencies.

* Be open to deep dives into new areas of the tech stack and learn new skills on the go.

* Be a stickler for developer productivity, and always be on the lookout to get things done more efficiently.

* Be effective at written and spoken communication. Also exhibit the same in writing code that can be well understood by other developers.

Preferred qualifications

* Be highly proficient on both sides: the back-end and the front-end described above, rather than one with agent-assisted contribution to the other.

* Be familiar with browser-based testing frameworks like Cypress to automate end-to-end user workflow tests, and with Core Web Vitals and how to build pages that render blazing fast, with measurements set up to be monitored continuously.

* Have an eye for extracting patterns for reusability that help ensure consistency across multiple applications.

* Previous experience working with visual elements like maps and charts that help display a massive amount of data in aggregated form.

* Prior experience working with Kafka, or with containerised 12-factor apps and tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

* Knowledge about the logistics and supply chain domain.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Position Description**
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Advanced Integration Builder team within Okta. This team builds and maintains the backend services, provisioning frameworks, authentication connectors, and next-generation Entitlement Management engines that let Okta customers secure, integrate, and govern access to thousands of third-party enterprise applications — from modern cloud platforms (Microsoft Office 365, Workday, Salesforce, AWS, ServiceNow) and AI agentic systems to legacy on-prem systems. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design and implementation of integration components end-to-end: REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication flows, user and group provisioning/sync jobs, and the retry and rate-limiting logic required to operate reliably against dozens of idiosyncratic third-party vendor APIs at scale. This is a backend-intensive role — the large majority of your time will be spent in Java/Spring Boot services — but you'll also need decent frontend experience in React and JSP to build and extend the screens that surface integration configuration to customers

  

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**
  

* Feature Execution: Drive technical design and implementation of integration features — new app connectors, provisioning/sync capabilities, authentication flows — primarily in backend Java services, extending into React/JSP configuration screens.
* Build and maintain REST/SOAP API clients, OAuth2/SAML authentication handlers , and vendor-specific exception/error-mapping layers for third-party SaaS and enterprise applications.
* Implement and extend user/group provisioning adapters built on shared contracts and scheduled sync/import jobs that keep identity data consistent between Okta and external systems.
* Resilience at Scale: Apply retry/backoff, rate-limiting, and pagination strategies to handle vendor API quirks, throttling, and intermittent failures gracefully across the dozens of concurrently supported integrations.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure credential/secret handling, token exchange, and audit logging for provisioning operations meet Okta's security and compliance standards.
* Product & Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with PMs, support, and technical leads to prioritize new app integrations, resolve customer-reported connectivity issues, and participate in technical interviews/recruiting.
* Operational Excellence: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues in integration pipelines, drive root-cause analyses, and improve observability/alerting for sync and provisioning jobs.
* Code Quality & Technical Standards: Participate in code reviews, write thorough unit and functional tests, and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
  

* Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating reliable, production-grade backend services.
* Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot; comfortable owning services end-to-end from design through production support.
* Distributed Systems: Experience with asynchronous job processing, scheduled/batch sync jobs, and event-driven patterns.
* Data Management: Proficiency with relational databases (MySQL) and caching layers (Redis or similar).
* Resilient Systems Design: Practical experience with retry/backoff strategies, rate-limiting, and handling pagination/throttling quirks from third-party APIs.
* API Design: Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including clients for third-party vendor systems with varying levels of API quality and documentation.
* Problem Solving & Ownership: Ability to break down ambiguous integration requirements and independently drive a feature from design to production.
* Decent Frontend Experience: While the role is backend-dominant, you should be comfortable building and modifying UI in React and JSP — well enough to independently deliver the frontend without relying on a dedicated frontend engineer.

**Nice to Haves**
  

* Experience with identity/IAM standards (SCIM, SAML, OAuth, OIDC) or directory services (AD, LDAP).
* Integration & Auth Protocols: Working knowledge of REST/SOAP API integration patterns and authentication standards such as OAuth2, SAML, or WS-Federation.
* Exposure to legacy protocol support (SOAP-based provisioning services) alongside modern REST/OAuth integrations.
* Familiarity with multi-tenant SaaS architectures or specialized compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP/GCC-High).
* Experience with message brokers/queueing systems (Kafka) for asynchronous processing.
* Exposure to HTTP mocking/test-server frameworks (e.g., WireMock or equivalent internal mock-server tooling) for API-level testing.

**Education**
  
B.E./M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
